name: Conservation Trust
summary: Funds large-scale, landscape-based conservation projects by Manitoba non-profit organisations, from a letter of interest in autumn to full applications and decisions the following spring. The trust is managed by The Winnipeg Foundation.

eligibility.rule: Not be a government body unless it is an Indigenous government
Run the project on public or private lands within Manitoba's working landscapes
No land purchases, buildings, major equipment, or standalone mapping-only projects
Do not propose conferences, wildlife feeding or rearing, law enforcement, or policy advocacy

eligibility.quote: Organizations without established operations in Manitoba
Governments (with the exception of Indigenous governments)
Project sites located on public and private lands within Manitoba's working landscapes

Land purchases and easements - Major capital assets such as buildings - Major equipment purchases (> $5000 per item) - Mapping-only projects that are not integral to the development of a larger Trust funded project

Conferences, lecture series, or conventions - Corral system projects* - Feeding or control of wildlife species - Fish or wildlife rearing, farming, stocking, or hatcheries projects - Law enforcement activities - Policy promotion and advocacy activities
